title: Sauna Exposure Load and Recovery Signal
dataSources: Continuous glucose (`cgm:glucose`), HRV (`hrv:reading`), mood check-ins (`mood:checkin`), ketone readings (`ketone:reading`), reaction-time trials (`reaction:trial`), sauna sessions (`sauna:session`), resting temperature (`temp:reading`), and meditation logs (`meditation:session`).
app: Biohacking telemetry from CGMs, HRV devices, ketone meters, mood and meditation journals, reaction-time apps, sauna logs, and health sensors streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=sauna:session
| eval week=strftime(_time,"%G-W%V")
| stats avg(duration_min) as avg_duration_min avg(post_session_hrv_delta) as avg_post_session_hrv_delta by week
| sort week
description: Tracks weekly sauna exposure along with the average short-term HRV change after each session.
value: Sauna can be restorative or fatiguing depending on context, and this couples exposure with a recovery-oriented metric.
implementation: Log session duration and a post-session HRV delta after sauna use, then summarize by week.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average sauna duration and HRV delta.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks how much sauna you are doing each week and whether it seems to leave you more recovered or more strained.
